topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I received a bouquet this morning, just sitting there on my doorstep without so much as a note. Who does that? Sends flowers without explaining why? It's a mystery wrapped in petals and tied with a bow, but not a fun one. I’m left here, trying to guess if this is some sort of silent message or just a random act of kindness gone badly wrong. It’s not like I can just call up the flower shop and demand to know the reasoning behind this. Now I’m stuck with these beautiful, yet infuriatingly silent, blooms.
